non_blocking_findings.finding: UX-004 improves Phase 4 migration UI but does not prove full migration/export parity.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep LEG-031 and LEG-032 as P0 blockers until Phase 6 validates complete export/import parity, real migration sources, and broader device matrix.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Preset appears as a visible export choice with a deferred/unavailable state, not as a data-backed export.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Implement preset owner selection/export in the task that owns new-session templates or preset management, then convert the deferred state to a real export.

non_blocking_findings.finding: UX-004 captured HMA-AL00 screenshots/XML for representative import/export sections, but did not run the full dark mode, dynamic type, TalkBack, IME, and small-screen matrix.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep all-up UI QA in NATIVE-UX-006 and do not treat UX-004 screenshot evidence as final visual acceptance.

non_blocking_findings.finding: The bottom navigation remains horizontally scrollable and Import/export can require a horizontal nav swipe on HMA-AL00.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Address top-level destination density in UX-003/UX-006 or a shell navigation follow-up; About and Import/export should eventually live under Settings per design docs.
